headline: Thailand wants tourists to pay 450 baht entry fee from 2027
summary: Thailand plans a 450 baht tourist levy on foreign visitors from 2027, applied first to air arrivals. The proposal is not final and requires public consultation and cabinet approval.
why: Tourism is a major source of foreign exchange and services revenue for Thailand. A visitor levy could affect arrival volumes and the earnings of airlines and hotels.
